about.description: VNX provides tokenized access to physical commodities and precious metals through blockchain infrastructure. It enables fractional ownership and efficient settlement of commodity positions.
about.registryInfo: VNX Global Ltd. is a Bermuda exempted company limited by shares which holds a Class M digital assets business licence issued by the Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA).

fees.revenueNotes: VNX earns float income on fiat reserves (EUR, CHF) held at Liechtenstein bank counterparties, plus a small mint/redeem spread for institutional flows. Storage fees on gold-backed VAUR token.
